Name: GetFilteredTasks
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: GetFilteredTasks, command: many)
SELECT
  id,
  priority > 5 as is_high,
  assigned_to IS NOT NULL as is_assigned,
  completed AND priority > 3 as important_done
FROM tasks
Template:
SELECT
  ⟨c0:id⟩,
  ⟨c1 aliased:priority > 5⟩ as is_high,
  ⟨c2 aliased:assigned_to IS NOT NULL⟩ as is_assigned,
  ⟨c3 aliased:completed AND priority > 3⟩ as important_done
FROM tasks
